decisions.reason: The colour-details clarification is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY, including the exclusion of a separate guidelines document.
The separate colour-variant clause is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY specifying full-colour, black, and white variants.
Clarifying that font and colour details replace a separate guidelines project does not change the requirement to provide editable source files.
The clarification about brand font and colour details does not alter the required with-black-box and without-black-box variants.
The guidance-scope clarification does not change the company wording, excluded word, or intended breadth of brand representation.
Requesting font details for brand consistency does not modify the approved letterform shapes or revision constraints.
The documentation clarification does not alter rev8-11 as the approved composition baseline.
The source distinguishes delivery of brand colour details from a separate guidelines project but does not change the approved logo colour treatment.
The scope of font guidance does not modify the logo's clean, characterful visual-style constraints.
The source does not change any requirement concerning readability or suitability across media and applications.
The brand-guidance clarification does not alter the strapline's side lines or graduated-colour treatment.
The source does not address or modify the flame-based O symbol or its recognition requirement.
